input_contract: A nonempty rectangular QQ matrix of canonical rationals {num:string,den:string}; entries have at most 64 rows.
output_contract: MatrixRankResult: original matrix, rank in [0,32], pivot_columns, method EXACT_RATIONAL_ROW_REDUCTION.
mathematical_binding: Gram matrix of the actual rational neighboring triple indicators t_{012},t_{034} under I-J/9. Both have norm 2 and their inner product is |intersection|-1=0. Exact rank 2 certifies the nondegeneracy used by the side 2->5 residual.
discovery: Argus adapter find --query 'exact rational matrix rank and nullspace'; selected only matrix.rank.compute after inspecting its exact typed schema.
limitation: This one bounded operation certifies this Gram matrix, not the full network. The standalone verifier rederives it from the indicator vectors.
